findings.description: During the first side-to-overhead arm raise, the reflected arm trails the real arm: at ~0:00.50 the real arm is horizontal while the reflected arm still angles downward; at ~0:01.25 the real arm is raised ~45-60 deg while the reflection is roughly horizontal; at ~0:01.50 the real arm is near vertical while the reflection is ~45 deg. The reflection reaches the matching pose only ~0.125-0.25 s later (synced by ~0:01.75). A mirror image cannot lag its source; perspective may account for part of the angle difference, so the lag is suggestive rather than certain.
